summary: Fix the gem collection crash that freezes rendering, along with broken spring pads, crumbling platforms staying solid after falling, the HUD height counter stopping at 10m, and inverted player facing.

bugs.title: Collecting a gem throws TypeError and freezes the render loop
bugs.evidence: At 0:48 in the video (step 4), touching a gem sets pl.gem = null and then immediately reads pl.gem.position.y in logEvent, throwing 'Cannot read properties of null (reading position)' and halting requestAnimationFrame.

bugs.title: Spring platforms barely bounce the player instead of launching with SPRING velocity
bugs.evidence: land() sets p.vy = JUMP * 0.4 (5.0) instead of the defined SPRING constant (22), which only reaches 0.39m height while nextPlatform() places the platform after a spring 4.5m to 6m higher.

bugs.title: Crumbling platforms remain solid in mid-air after falling away
bugs.evidence: In updatePlatforms(), when pl.crumbleT > 0.55 and pl.falling becomes true, pl.active is never set to false, so updatePlayer() keeps the player standing on or colliding with the original platform height.

bugs.title: HUD height display stops updating once height reaches 10m
bugs.evidence: updateHud() checks 'if (h !== shownH && h < 10)' before updating hHeight.textContent, freezing the displayed altitude above 9m.

bugs.title: Player character faces opposite to movement direction
bugs.evidence: At 0:39 in the video, the player's eyes (+Z in local space) face right while moving left because updateVisuals() computes Math.atan2(-p.vx, -p.vz) instead of Math.atan2(p.vx, p.vz).

edits.why: Fix: read gem position before nulling pl.gem so collecting a gem does not throw and freeze the game.

edits.find: if (h !== shownH && h < 10) { shownH = h; hHeight.textContent = h; }
edits.replace: if (h !== shownH) { shownH = h; hHeight.textContent = h; }
edits.why: Fix: update the HUD height counter at all altitudes instead of capping updates below 10m.

edits.find: if (pl.crumbleT > 0.55) { pl.falling = true; sfx.crack(); burst(pl.x, pl.y, pl.z, 10, 0.8); }
edits.replace: if (pl.crumbleT > 0.55) { pl.falling = true; pl.active = false; sfx.crack(); burst(pl.x, pl.y, pl.z, 10, 0.8); }
edits.why: Fix: mark crumbling platforms inactive when they fall so they no longer support the player in mid-air.

edits.find:
if (pl.type === "spring") {
        p.vy = JUMP * 0.4; p.springing = true; p.sq = 0.55;
edits.replace:
if (pl.type === "spring") {
        p.vy = SPRING; p.springing = true; p.sq = 0.55;
edits.why: Fix: launch the player with SPRING velocity when landing on a spring pad.
Fix: orient the player's front (+Z eyes/cheeks) toward the direction of travel.

summary: Fix the HUD 'Best' score not updating live when surpassing the previous best during a run.

bugs.title: HUD 'Best' score does not update live during play when surpassing previous best
bugs.evidence: At 01:11–01:35 in the video, the player climbs from 5 m to 7 m while the top-right 'Best' chip continues to display 4 until the game-over screen appears at 01:40, because best is only updated inside gameOver().

bugs.title: Not a bug: fell off platforms at 0 m and 7 m
bugs.evidence: At 00:13 and 01:35 the player jumped in the wrong direction or misjudged the platform jump and fell; the 650 ms delay before the game over card appears at 00:18 and 01:40 is an intentional fall transition.

edits.why: Fix: show the live best height in the HUD chip as soon as the current climb exceeds the saved best.
